subject: Spectra AI — Customer Video: logistics & release
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena@spectra.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick chat — Spectra testimonial?

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for the call this morning. We're excited to participate in a short customer video sharing how Spectra AI uses Redwood Inference to reduce inference cost and improve consistency across environments.

High-level from our side:
- We can do an on-site half-day shoot the week of July 26 or a remote-recorded session (Zoom + local backup) the week of Aug 2.
- Primary speaker: me (VP Product). Secondary speaker: our Head of ML, Priya Shah (she can join remotely if needed).
- We care about a brief (2–4 minute) piece focused on deployment simplicity and cost savings.

Attached our brand guidelines for reference.

A couple of asks: Do you have a production run-of-show and a standard release form (we prefer non-edit clause for quotes)? Also what facts can we call out on cost savings — do you want us to use the public case figures or do a specific metric tied to our account?

Best,
Elena

[Attachment: Spectra_Brand_Guidelines.pdf (PDF)]
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena@spectra.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick chat — Spectra testimonial?

Elena — great to hear and thanks for the clarity.

We can absolutely accommodate either option; our recommendation for easiest turnaround is a half-day on-site (30–45 minute interview + B-roll) on July 28, but remote on Aug 2 also works.

Quick answers to your asks:
- We typically ask for a signed release (non-exclusive, standard marketing rights). If you need a non-edit clause we can add it as an exception — please flag exact language.
- For metrics: we can provide an account-specific delta for per-token cost and a latency percentile number you can call out. I will loop ops to confirm exact figures, but a safe public-facing line is: "reduced inference unit cost by ~40% while maintaining p95 latency under X ms" — we can firm the numbers once ops signs off.

I've attached a draft shot list and a high-level script outline for Marissa to refine. Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm in-person vs remote and speakers by Friday 7/16.
2) Marissa to share final script and release for signatures by 7/19.
3) We send DocuSign, and I book crew if on-site.

Thanks — looking forward.

Hannah Schmitt
Account Director, Customer Advocacy
Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com | (415) 555-0189

[Attachment: Spectra_Testimonial_Shotlist_v1.xlsx (Excel)]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morales <elena@spectra.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 11:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spectra AI — Customer Video: logistics & release

Looping Ben for logistics (camera/crew) and adding a first script draft below.

Script draft (2–3 minute cut):
- Opening (Elena, 10–15s): Intro + what Spectra does.
- The problem (Elena, 20s): scale + inconsistent inference costs pre-Redwood.
- Why Redwood (Elena + Priya soundbite, 40s): deployment consistency, unified API, reduced ops toil.
- Results (Elena, 30s): share top-line outcome + business impact.
- Close (Elena, 10s): recommendation and next steps.

Questions for the interview (short, conversational):
1) What was the single biggest pain with your previous setup?
2) How did Redwood change team workflows day-to-day?
3) Any specific metric you'd call out for the case study?

Attached: release_v1 (editable) and a tentative call sheet. Please review and call out any language changes — Elena, I added a single-line non-edit request, highlighted in yellow.

Marissa Cole
Senior Program Manager, Customer Stories
marissa_cole@redwood.com

[Attachment: Spectra_Release_v1.docx (DOCX)]
From: Elena Morales <elena@spectra.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Spectra AI — Customer Video: logistics & release

Thanks Marissa — this looks solid. A few notes: 
- We prefer the non-edit clause for short quotes (no edits to direct quotes without approval); full-length B-roll/visual edits are fine. Can you add a 48-hour review window post-first-cut?
- For metrics: we ran a household-level benchmark and are comfortable calling out "~38% reduction in per-inference unit cost" and calling out p95 latency ~120ms for production traffic. Are those numbers okay to include?
- Priya will be on standby for the tech soundbites — she wants the shortlist of technical prompts to prep.

If that works, we'll sign the release via DocuSign. Please include a copy of the finalized script for Priya to review.

Elena

- Speakers: Elena (on-site) + Priya (remote interview slot at 10:30am PT).
- Finalized numbers: ~38% reduction in per-inference unit cost; p95 ~120ms (agreed for public call-out).
- Release: We've moved the non-edit clause into an appendix and added a 48-hour review window for the first cut. Please sign via DocuSign by 7/22.
- Deliverables: 2–4 minute edited video + 30s social cut + still frames.

Attachments: call sheet (crew timeline), DocuSign link, final shot list. Ben — please confirm wrap time and parking for the crew; Marissa — please send final script for Priya to review by EOD 7/20.
